description.value: Chewies Oyster Bar is a New Orleans-inspired oyster bar and full-service restaurant in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, steps from the Seaside Greenway cycling route on West 1st Avenue. The menu spans brunch, dinner, and happy hour with a clear focus on fresh oysters and elevated casual seafood dining. The venue also accommodates private events and large-party bookings with shucking stations and multiple bar setups.
